thread:
Jorge (Support): FYI BrightLeaf reported a billing problem — they'd asked for Net 60 but their card was charged and declined on invoice generation. PO# BL-7782 attached to the case.
Priya (Acct Ops): Yikes. Do we have a record that Net 60 was fully applied in billing metadata? Which invoice id?
Jorge (Support): invoice_2026_00987 — gateway returned `insufficient_funds`. Customer says sales promised arrears (Net 60). They also flagged a VAT mismatch.
Elena (Finance): I'm looking. Sales approved Net terms in SF but the billing subscription still has `prepay_required=true`. That would trigger an immediate charge at invoice time.
Devon (Billing): That flag is set on subscription metadata. Quick check shows prepay still enabled for BL-7782. Repro steps below.
Devon (Billing): ```
# repro
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" \
  https://billing.redwood.ai/subscriptions/BL-7782 | jq .metadata
# -> { "prepay_required": "true", "net_terms": "60" }
```
Jorge (Support): Customer wants provisional credit and confirmation Net 60 will apply. Also VAT: customer provided VAT `GB12345` but invoice shows `GB123456`. They say a digit typo on our side.
Elena (Finance): We can issue a provisional credit (credit memo) while we validate docs. Need signed PO and correct VAT ID. If Sales confirms the Net 60 promise, finance will waive any late fees for this incident.
Priya (Acct Ops): PO signed by procurement@brightleaf.co on 2026-02-28 — uploading to case 4921. Also pinged Sales for confirmation email.
Devon (Billing): Proposed remediation steps (pending finance approval):
1) Create provisional credit memo CM-4921 for invoice_2026_00987.
2) Patch subscription metadata `prepay_required=false`.
3) Re-run invoice processing without charging card (mark as Net 60).
4) If card retries are enabled, ensure we don’t auto-retry and cause duplicate attempts.
Jorge (Support): Can we do steps 1+2 now so customer sees movement? They're worried about service interruption.
Elena (Finance): I'll approve CM-4921 for provisional credit up to the invoice amount as long as we get signed PO and corrected VAT within 5 business days. After docs, we will finalize the memo.
Priya (Acct Ops): Noted. I've asked Sales to post a short confirmation in the ticket that Net 60 was promised. @sam_sales please reply in the case thread.
ops-bot: Created incident billing-4930: "Net terms applied in CRM but prepay flag still enabled -> card declined; VAT mismatch reported". Assigned to Billing and Finance.
Jorge (Support): I'll update BrightLeaf with provisional credit confirmation and request corrected VAT + Sales confirmation. Will follow up here when docs land. Thanks :thumbsup:
Elena (Finance): If the VAT ID is corrected to `GB12345` and PO signed, we'll finalize and convert provisional credit to a permanent credit memo and set account to Net 60 moving forward.
Devon (Billing): After Finance sign-off I'll run the metadata patch: `PATCH /subscriptions/BL-7782 { "metadata": { "prepay_required": "false" } }` and re-ingest invoice.
Priya (Acct Ops): Added checklist to the case: signed PO, corrected VAT ID, Sales confirmation email.
Jorge (Support): Customer asked whether Net 60 counts from invoice date or service start — standard policy is invoice date. I'll confirm waiver of late fees if they provide docs within 7 days.
Priya (Acct Ops): Confirmed waiver policy. Will coordinate with Finance if anything changes.
Jorge (Support): Closing loop with customer now. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
